Agent limitations

Supports baseline, original Learn and compatible policy comparison. Separate reference-context and completion research studies are not supported.

Adapter v2 is a separate agent from v1 (the same smolagents code): it shows each observation it hands to the agent as a short label (obs-1, obs-2, …, numbered in the order the agent first sees them; an observation it never sees gets no label), decodes the labels it showed back to the real IDs, and on the final turn offers only final_answer with a structured final-report format. Its results are never pooled with adapter v1.

Before the Explorer picks anything, re-runs up to 3 recipes from this agent's frozen history that fired every fault and failed in at least 2 of every 3 verified episodes (one agent episode each, no Explorer request); the remaining slots are exactly v3 · agent history.

The first slots replay the plan's frozen history replay list: each runs one Actor episode of that history row's recipe, without an Explorer request. MODEL TRANSPORT RETRIES
Agent (Actor) requests: at most one charged retry per request that received no answer (connection error, timeout, HTTP 503) · at most 8 per episode · Explorer and Mechanic requests: up to 3 charged retries each, after waits of 5 s, 20 s, 60 s · at most 12 per campaign · a Stop during a wait ends the campaign STOPPED · never after an answer · never an extra turn

Agent roles (the reference Actor and the native smolagents adapters) keep rule v1: at most one blind retry of the identical request, only when no answer arrived (a connection error, a timeout, or HTTP 503 after a one-second wait). FaultLab's own lab roles in this Learn campaign (Explorer discovery and challenge selections, Mechanic diagnosis and candidate requests) may re-send the identical request up to 3 times, after waits of 5 s, 20 s and 60 s, only when no answer arrived (connection error, timeout, HTTP 503), and at most 12 times in the whole campaign; during discovery the declared Explorer retry bound also applies. An answer, even an empty or malformed one, is never retried, and neither is any other HTTP status or an authentication, configuration or model-identity failure. Every retry is charged in model calls, tokens and dollars before it is sent, from unreserved campaign capacity only. A Stop during a wait ends the campaign STOPPED and nothing more is sent. If every allowed retry fails, the campaign ends ERROR as before and says how many retries were tried. Separate studies started on the campaign keep rule v1.

AUTOMATIC EVIDENCE RETRIES
Up to 3 per evidence wait and 6 per campaign (after 30 s, 120 s, 300 s) · telemetry only: no episode, business action or model request is repeated, nothing is charged · then “needs operator”

While a Learn campaign waits for verified Weave evidence, FaultLab retries the evidence by itself at most 3 times per wait and at most 6 times per campaign: 30 s, 120 s and 300 s after the wait starts or after the previous retry still left the evidence unverified. Each automatic retry uses the same telemetry-only path as Retry evidence sync: it re-sends the saved trace records of the episodes the wait needs and reads them back. It never runs an episode, a business tool or a model request again, and charges nothing to the campaign budget. Every attempt is recorded. When a limit is reached the campaign keeps waiting and shows "needs operator"; Retry evidence sync and Stop still work. A stop during the wait ends the campaign as STOPPED.
